items.title: Intraday coverage expansion on a frozen completed-bar frontier: two owner tools (options-flow-feed-lab, ai-capex-strategy-lab) that published no fresh read at the earlier 04:08 ET pre-market cutoff now publish fresh headless reads at the 11:00 ET cutoff, yet the completed-daily-bar frontier stays FROZEN at 2026-08-03 (expectedSessionDate unchanged, 287/287 fresh, swing bars 507) — so brief tool coverage (richCount) widens WITHOUT a new completed bar, and any repeated rotation leg's distinct-completed-bar-date persistence MUST NOT increment.
items.note: Genuinely new versus the prior same-window 'frozen-frontier pre-market markdown' pattern (which tracked the live BENCH repricing lower on a frozen frontier). Here the novelty is on the COVERAGE axis, not the price axis: across two pre-market 2026-08-04 cutoffs on the SAME completed-bar frontier (04:08:51.922Z -> 11:00:19.764Z), options-flow-feed-lab and ai-capex-strategy-lab both flip from no-fresh-read (marked non-analyzed at 04:08) to fresh headless reads at 11:00 — options-flow-feed now reads call-heavy / leaning bullish (TSLA 320C $47.5M at 24.6x OI; call fraction 0.85) and ai-capex now reads Grid & Electrical leading the assumptions-based mix at 20.4% (6m band 8.6%, -17.7% to 43.3%). Meanwhile dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate stays 2026-08-03 (287/287 fresh, 0 carried, 0 missing) and swing bars stay 507, so the completed-bar frontier is frozen and the XLY rotate-into's distinct-completed-bar-date persistence stays at three dates (07-30, 07-31, 08-03) — NOT incremented. The deterministic regime eased slightly over the same span (VIX 15.86 band 'VIX 15.9' -> 15.62 band 'VIX 15.6', score 0 both) while bench SPY held 747.03 (maStack bull-stack, -1.4% off the 52-week high) and the carried 08-03 options structure kept its positive-gamma flip at 743.36 (walls 740/758, EM ±3.81, signedNetGEX +3.287B). Signature: tactical read coverage widened intraday on an unchanged completed-bar frontier — new tactical inputs entered the brief while structure and persistence stayed put.
items.method: Add a 'coverage-expansion-on-frozen-frontier' composite test that compares two cutoffs on the SAME session frontier (dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate unchanged AND swing bar count unchanged AND freshSymbolCount==symbolCount with carriedSymbolCount==0 and missingSymbolCount==0). Assert THREE joint conditions: (1) FRONTIER FROZEN across the two cutoffs; (2) COVERAGE RISE = the count of owner tools returning a fresh headless read INCREASES, i.e. at least one tool flips from no-fresh-read to fresh-headless between the cutoffs (here options-flow-feed-lab and ai-capex-strategy-lab); (3) PERSISTENCE GUARD = any repeated rotation leg's distinct-completed-bar-date counter is UNCHANGED (XLY held at 3 dates). Emit the experimental flag only when (1) AND (2) hold, so an ordinary quiet re-read with no coverage change does not trip it; the flag marks that new TACTICAL reads entered the brief without a new completed bar (structure/persistence unchanged while tactical coverage widened) — the coverage-axis mirror of the price-axis 'frozen-frontier markdown' pattern.
